interventions.description: Use lane narrowing or a road diet to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this institutional area.

interventions.title: Install a Furnishing Zone/Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street furniture between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the perceived and actual safety of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers such as bollards or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from the travel lane.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Designated Loading and Vending Zones
interventions.description: Establish specific off-sidewalk or curb-side zones for commercial loading and food trucks to keep the pedestrian clear path unobstructed.
